therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Targeted delivery of cytotoxic payload to CLDN18.2-expressing tumor cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with unresectable or metastatic CLDN18.2-positive gastric, pancreatic, ovarian and biliary tract tumors

results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional PK observed with Cmax ranging from 5,845 ng/mL (0.15 mg/kg) to 19,801 ng/mL (0.60 mg/kg)
safety_signals: Related Grade ≥3 TEAE in 1 patient at highest dose
results.dose_information: Dose escalation from 0.15 mg/kg to 0.60 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks, no DLTs observed
